title: Sam Altman says OpenAI offered to invest $2M in tokens in each startup in the current YC batch; a source says the offer is in exchange for equity via SAFE (Jemima McEvoy/The Information)
commentary: OpenAI offering YC startups $2M in tokens — not cash — in exchange for equity is either the most elegant customer acquisition strategy in startup history or a very expensive way to lock developers into your API before they consider Anthropic.
